**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-repo `filter` package — `internal/filter/` (`engine.go:26` `Engine`, `NewEngine` :16, `Compile` :47; schema in `schema.go`, SQL rendering in `render.go`, helpers in `helpers.go`). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to a dialect-agnostic `Condition` tree, then `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, filters, dialect, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`) renders it per dialect via `renderer` (`render.go:10`) using the per-dialect expression templates and placeholder style keyed by `DialectSQLite`/`DialectMySQL`/`DialectPostgres` (`schema.go:14-16, 104-146`), and each driver appends the resulting SQL + args to its WHERE clause (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`).

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (explicit code in `store/memo.go:142,145,153-157,158`). Plus `memo_share` by DB-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:108`) — note this does not fire on SQLite because FKs are disabled in the DSN (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`, `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)`). Comment memos are deleted through the same path (extra `memo`/`memo_relation`/`attachment` rows) at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577`. `reaction` rows are read but not deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React bundle is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served as static files via Echo's `middleware.StaticWithConfig` plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:40-59` (`Serve`), fallback at `:62-78`; invoked from `server/server.go:71` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — started at server/server.go:158-167; RunOnce at startup, then a time.Ticker every 12h (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
```
That is the only background runner started. Unused infrastructure:
- `internal/scheduler` — a full cron scheduler package (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `doc.go`) with **zero** imports anywhere outside its own package/tests.
- `server/runner/memopayload` — exposes `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` (`runner.go:19,27`), but only its plain function `RebuildMemoPayload` is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`); the runner is never instantiated by the server.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:155-181`, installed on the Connect transport (`web/src/connect.ts:184-190`). Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT **access token** (in-memory/stored via `web/src/auth-state.ts`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`), refreshed against a **refresh token** held in an HTTP-only cookie (`credentials: "include"`, `refreshAuthClient.refreshToken` — `web/src/connect.ts:56-72,74-81`), with proactive expiry refresh and reactive retry on `Unauthenticated`. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go`, `token.go` — access tokens 15 min / `user.access-token`, refresh tokens 30 d / cookie `memos_refresh`, plus `memos_pat_` Personal Access Tokens), driven by `Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` and the Connect `AuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213-231`) and gateway middleware (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:68-92`).

The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:182` / `:117`.
